description: Source code for handling frontmatter parsing, validation, and resolution for skills in the OpenClaw project. Includes functions for normalizing specifications, resolving metadata, and defining skill invocation policies.

methods.name: parseFrontmatter
methods.description: Parses the frontmatter content string into a structured ParsedSkillFrontmatter object.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawMetadata
methods.description: Resolves and returns the OpenClawSkillMetadata from parsed frontmatter.

methods.name: resolveSkillInvocationPolicy
methods.description: Determines the invocation policy for a skill based on frontmatter.

methods.name: resolveSkillKey
methods.description: Generates a unique skill key, defaulting to skill name if not specified in entry metadata.
